title: Healthcare Staff Scheduling Software | Managed Service
description: Healthcare staff scheduling software that works for you, not against you. Our managed service builds physician and APP schedules and hands them back finished.
h1: Healthcare Staff Scheduling, Built For You
paragraph: Forget learning healthcare staff scheduling software. Send us your rules and we build the schedule. We cover physicians and advanced practice providers.

cta.title: Stop Running Schedules on Spreadsheets
cta.description: Book a call to talk through your scheduling needs and learn how Scheduling Wizard works. Join 30+ departments across 20+ hospitals and practices that have us build their call, block, clinic and shift schedules.

faq.answer: Physicians and advanced practice providers, in residency and fellowship programs, provider groups and practices. Nursing and hourly staff rostering is a different job with a different rule set, and we do not build those schedules; a general workforce platform is the better route there. If your problem is the physician and APP side, that is the part we take over entirely.
faq.question: Which staff does Scheduling Wizard schedule?

faq.answer: For a residency or fellowship we build the ACGME requirements in as the schedule is created rather than auditing it afterward: the 80-hour limit (averaged over four weeks), minimum rest, the 24-hour cap, and the specialty-specific Program Requirements. We work from the requirements your program tells us apply, and we redraft when something needs to change.
faq.question: How do you handle ACGME duty hours?

faq.answer: Most healthcare staff scheduling software is self-service; you buy it, learn it, and operate it yourself. Scheduling Wizard is a managed service. Programs submit their rules and our schedulers deliver a finished, ready-to-publish schedule. There is no platform to log into and no software to maintain. Many Scheduling Wizard clients also use the platform they already have alongside it. Scheduling Wizard handles the schedule building, while the platform you already use handles day-to-day schedule viewing.
faq.question: How is Scheduling Wizard different from other healthcare staff scheduling software?

faq.answer: Scheduling Wizard generates Block and rotation schedules, Call schedules with fair call distribution, Clinic schedules, and Attending physician schedules. All schedule types are built together, so that rules in one schedule are reflected across the others. Finished schedules are delivered as Excel or Google Sheets, or on a custom live view we build for you that programs can upload directly to their existing publishing platform.
faq.question: What types of schedules does Scheduling Wizard generate?

faq.answer: With traditional healthcare staff scheduling software, institutional scheduling knowledge often leaves when a chief rotates out. With Scheduling Wizard, your program's rules and requests are kept year over year. Incoming chief residents inherit the written rule set and last year's schedule and do not need to rebuild the scheduling rules from scratch. This continuity is a core part of the managed service model.
faq.question: What happens to our scheduling setup when a new chief resident takes over?

faq.answer: Physician and advanced practice provider schedules, for residency and fellowship programs, provider groups and private practices. On the GME side that means chief residents, program directors, coordinators and GME offices; on the group side, practice administrators and managing partners. We currently serve 30+ departments across 20+ hospitals and practices.
faq.question: Who is Scheduling Wizard designed for?

items.title: Requirements Built In From the Start
highlights: Subspecialty rules you give us built in
items.description: We build each schedule to the rules that govern it. For a residency or fellowship that means the ACGME duty hour requirements and the specialty-specific Program Requirements. For a provider group or practice it means yours: coverage minimums, call equity, contractual obligations, time off and requests, and multiple sites where a group has them.

items.description: Your program's scheduling rules and requests stay written down with Scheduling Wizard year over year. Incoming chiefs inherit the written rule set and last year's schedule instead of rebuilding from a blank spreadsheet.
